item.title: Zinnia: A modular 64-bit Unix-like kernel written in Rust
item.description:
📝 These are Rust ELF dylibs which get loaded and linked during boot from an initrd, similar to Linux systems. Zinnia can boot from any UEFI based system thanks to the Limine bootloader. I started this project in 2024 to learn more about systems programming, but over time it started gain more and more features.
🔗 Read more: https://zinnia-os.org/

item.title: Yserver: A modern X11 server written in Rust
item.description:
📝 yserver A modern X11 server written from scratch in Rust. Status yserver (standalone DRM/KMS) can now run full MATE/XFCE/Cinnamon desktops. conf: [Seat:*] xserver-command=/usr/local/bin/yserver From a free TTY, restart lightdm: sudo systemctl restart lightdm.
🔗 Read more: https://github.com/joske/yserver

item.title: Chaosnet (1981)
item.description:
📝 The system goals for Chaosnet were primarily simplicity and high performance. These protocols can be (and are) used with media other than the Chaosnet cable, and with multiple interconnected cables. The transmission medium of Chaosnet is called the ether.
🔗 Read more: https://tumbleweed.nu/r/lm-3/uv/amber.html
